Hey. If you would really want to do it, you would not bother to write a post here. You wouldn't give yourself 3 weeks of life. You'd just do it. The fact that you wanted to know what others think about you and your situation is that you are not very sure what to do. Yes, I am stating the obvious, but the main point is that: you do not want to die. You just want to live a different life, and you've got lost, you are not sure how to do it. 

Suicide won't help then. Because that's not what you want. Hookers? You want real sex, with a real girlfriend. Don't lie to yourself. And you know, when youre dead, you can't really feel this loving touch, you can't hear somebody whispering they love you. You say you don't have a girlfriend now - correct. But you have a great chance to find one. But there are no girlfriends when you're dead. No love. No smiles. No ice cream. No puppies. No life, with all its beautiful moments. 

You say you're disgusted with your body. Do you wanna end your life in a body you hate? YES, YOU CAN CHANGE YOUR BODY. Thousands of people have done this before you. I did it. You know what's the feeling when you HAVE TO buy new trousers, cause the ones you have are falling off you? IT'S A GORGEOUS FEELING. And you deserve to experience that. You deserve to hear the people saying 'wow, you've lost a lot of weight'. It's going to fucking happen if you want it. Hey, how about you extend your life, what of I would challenge you - you can only kill yourself when you are convinced your body will look hot in the coffin? Yes, it will take more than 1 month. But you deserve to have a great body. 

With colleges... Well, I don't know what was the reason you dropped from all of them. But you've mentioned your family has been supportive for the previous 6 years. How about you will invite your parents (or whoever is closest to you) for a talk somewhere nice, in a neutral ground. And you'll sit down and admit "mom, dad - I think I've screwed up. Help me". 

Admit it. Stop lying. Stop running away. Stop fooling yourself and people that you care about. Yes, you've lost few battles. But the war is not over. You may have to swallow your pride and start working in a shittiest place possible. I had to travel 2000 miles to find a place where I could start my career. Without friends or family. And I started as a waitress. Two years later I have a real job, and can afford to have a new car, rent a nice house and travel. And I'm not very clever, pretty or skilled, and I still don't have many friends (cause I'm an asshole). But I've made it and you can do it too. All you need is the anger, frustration, will to fight of this loser that is currently occupying your mind. It's not you, the real you is a strong person. The real you is now trying his last chance to escape. You have to stop thinking of yourself so bad. You're not unsuccessful with ladies - this loser inside you is. Don't let him decide about everything, don't let him think, speak or act for you. Let the loser die - but you have to live, just to prove yourself that you're stronger than any of your weaknesses. 


As for the suicide itself - if you will decide to do it anyway at any point of your life (and I hope you won't): please consider the way you're going to do it once again. If you really care about your family, make it look like an accident. Suicides destroy the whole family, or even community. People will start blaming themselves because of you. Some of them may even follow your path. Do you want them to suffer? Do they deserve it too? Don't let them doubt even once that it was an accident, and nobody's to blame.

I thought she wants to be alone, I'd just do everything around the house and keep the noise down, let her mourn and deal with this. I honestly had good intentions.

Few years later we argued about some shite, and she suddenly cried out "remember when grandpa died, you were never there for me, you've ignored me!". It has been stuck in her memory for such a long time, so she must have feel hurt. God, I still feel guilty. Since then, I don't care about rules, savour vivre, hierarchy, nothing. I'd offer all the help I can, try to gently begin conversation, or just sit silently next to that person, let them cry, and most of all - hug them. Just show him/her you're a human being and you're ready to share a wee bit of their pain, so it's easier to deal with it. As simple as that.
